AI-Powered Procurement & Dynamic Workflow Automation | Procyn

5m

Follow

🚀 We are hiring! Join the team building the future of intelligent procurement.

At Procyn (procyn.in), we are on a mission to simplify purchasing, automate complex approval workflows, and build high-performance SaaS solutions that help businesses scale. To do that, we need incredible builders—and we are looking for a skilled Full Stack Developer to join our growing engineering team!

If you love taking ownership, working with modern tech stacks, and designing robust, scalable applications from database to UI, we want to hear from you. 💻

🌍 The Role: Full Stack Developer
📍 Location: Remote (India)
⚙️ Our Tech Identity: Next-generation workflow automation & data-rich enterprise dashboard interfaces.

What You’ll Do:

Design, build, and optimize scalable web applications and features.
Develop intuitive, high-performance UI using React/Next.js and build robust APIs with Node.js.
Work on PostgreSQL, and AWS cloud infrastructures to ensure speed, uptime, and security.
Collaborate closely with our product team to translate workflow automated processes into smooth digital experiences.

What We’re Looking For:
Proven experience as a Full Stack Developer (Frontend + Backend).
Solid grasp of JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, and Databases (SQL).
Experience with RESTful APIs, cloud environments (AWS).
A problem-solver who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced startup environment.

Why join Procyn?
Work on a cutting-edge platform solving real-world enterprise procurement problems.
A collaborative, growth-focused, and highly ambitious culture.
Opportunity to make a direct, tangible impact on our core product.

📥 How to Apply: If you're ready to build the next generation of procurement and dynamic workflows, send your resume/portfolio 
to: 📧 contact@procyn.in (Please use the subject line: Application: Full Stack Developer - [Your Name])

Know someone who would be a perfect fit? Tag them in the comments or share this post! 🙌
